snippet.title: Rücktritt von Bärbel Bas: So reagiert SPD-Chef Klingbeil | #bas #klingbeil #spd
snippet.description:
Mit eindringlichen Worten hat SPD-Chef Lars Klingbeil die Angriffe auf seine zurückgetretene Ko-Parteichefin Bärbel Bas kritisiert. Bas sei "in Zeiten des persönlichen Leids und der persönlichen Trauer politischen Angriffen ausgesetzt" gewesen, sagte Klingbeil am Montag in Berlin. "Das ist unanständig und niemand in unserem Land sollte das ertragen müssen." Er beklagte auch, dass es "insbesondere die Frauen in herausgehobenen Führungspositionen", die so etwas immer stärker erleben müssten.

Bas hatte ihren Rücktritt als SPD-Ko-Chefin und Arbeitsministerin mit der Trauer nach dem Tod ihrer Stieftochter, aber auch mit "öffentlichen Angriffen" von Seiten des Koalitionspartners Union begründet.

"Bärbel Bas hat deutlich gemacht, dass jetzt Grenzen erreicht sind", sagte Klingbeil. "Wir brauchen eine Kultur des Streits, aber wir brauchen auch eine Kultur des Respekts miteinander und voreinander." 

-----

Diskutiert in Livestreams mit uns und bildet euch eure eigene Meinung mit den Fakten, die wir euch präsentieren.

Abonniert unseren Kanal, um nichts mehr zu verpassen.

snippet.title: Vrat Wale Mathey Ke Aloo ❤️ | Navratri Vrat Recipe | UP Special Dahi Aloo | व्रत वाले आलू #shorts
snippet.description:
Looking for something different from the usual Navratri fasting dishes? ❤️ Try these Vrat Wale Mathey Ke Aloo — a vrat-friendly version of our famous Etawah-style Mathey Ke Aloo from Uttar Pradesh! 🤌🏻
Made with potatoes, tangy buttermilk (chaas), green chillies and a few simple ingredients, this comforting dish is perfect for Navratri vrat. Serve it with vrat wali puri, paratha or samak rice for a delicious fasting meal. 😍🙏🏻
💡 Tip: Mix a little singhare ka atta, kuttu ka atta or rajgira atta into the buttermilk before adding it to help stabilise the mixture.
🇬🇧 Recipe – Vrat Wale Mathey Ke Aloo
Ingredients:
4–5 boiled potatoes, roughly chopped
500 ml chaas (buttermilk)
½ cup water
1 tbsp ghee
½ tsp cumin seeds (jeera)
2–3 green chillies
1 tsp singhare ka atta, kuttu ka atta or rajgira atta (optional)
Salt, to taste
Kashmiri red chilli powder (optional, for colour)
Fresh coriander leaves, chopped
Method:
🥣 In a bowl, whisk the chaas until smooth. If using vrat-friendly flour, mix 1 tsp into the chaas until no lumps remain.
🔥 Heat ghee in a kadhai. Add cumin seeds and green chillies; let them splutter.
🥔 Add the boiled potatoes and sauté for about 1 minute.
💧 Add ½ cup water and the chaas mixture.
🥄 Keep stirring continuously until the first boil. This helps prevent the chaas from splitting.
🧂 Add salt and Kashmiri red chilli powder, if using.
🍲 Cook until the sabzi reaches your desired consistency.
🌿 Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.
❤️ Enjoy with vrat wali puri, paratha or samak rice!
🇮🇳 रेसिपी – व्रत वाले मट्ठे के आलू
सामग्री:
4–5 उबले हुए आलू, मोटे टुकड़ों में कटे हुए
500 ml मट्ठा / छाछ
½ कप पानी
1 बड़ा चम्मच घी
½ छोटा चम्मच जीरा
2–3 हरी मिर्च
1 छोटा चम्मच सिंघाड़े का आटा, कुट्टू का आटा या राजगिरा आटा (वैकल्पिक)
स्वादानुसार नमक
कश्मीरी लाल मिर्च पाउडर (वैकल्पिक, सिर्फ रंग के लिए)
बारीक कटा हरा धनिया
विधि:
🥣 सबसे पहले छाछ को अच्छी तरह फेंट लें। अगर व्रत वाला आटा डालना है, तो 1 छोटा चम्मच आटा छाछ में अच्छी तरह मिला लें ताकि गांठें न रहें।
🔥 कढ़ाई में घी गरम करें। जीरा और हरी मिर्च डालकर चटकने दें।
🥔 अब उबले हुए आलू डालकर लगभग 1 मिनट भूनें।
💧 इसमें ½ कप पानी और तैयार छाछ का मिश्रण डालें।
🥄 लगातार चलाते रहें और पहला उबाल आने दें। इससे छाछ फटने की संभावना कम होती है।
🧂 अब स्वादानुसार नमक और कश्मीरी लाल मिर्च पाउडर डालें।
🍲 सब्ज़ी को अपनी पसंद की गाढ़ाई तक पकाएं।
🌿 हरा धनिया डालकर गरमा-गरम परोसें।
❤️ इसे व्रत वाली पूरी, पराठे या समक चावल के साथ खाएं!

snippet.title: Мой домашний кондитер согрешил
snippet.description:
Это сейчас я уже месяц без работы, а раньше у меня совершенно не было времени. Доставки, разборки с сетями и контроль производства напрочь выматывал! И все торты домой на праздник я заказывал у своих знакомых кондитеров. Фраза сапожник бед сапог, это про меня))) Но я заказывал всегда натуральные, а тут вот такая ситуация😢.  Теперь буду делать сам своей семье
Кстати : 
Рассказываю, чтобы вы были внимательнее. Сейчас растительные сливки стали очень высокого качества (например, такие как «Шантипак»), что даже я, с опытом работы в кондитерской 11 лет, не сразу смог отличить их от натуральных. В крем-чизе достаточно большое количество сыра, и после застывания (стабилизации) этого крема очень сложно выявить «растишку». 

Но я знаю два способа: 

Это небольшая масляная пленка, которая остается на губах и убирается только механически (салфеткой, рукой). 

Это белый цвет. Речь идет не о кристально-белом цвете, но о белом. Натуральный крем-чиз имеет молочный цвет, а «растишка» — белая.

И есть еще один: когда крем при нарезке или отламывании ложкой начинает рваться. Но визуально без опыта это сложно определить, поэтому я не записал это в основной способ.

In a world filled with challenges and uncertainties, finding a source of strength and hope is essential. Many turn to self-help books or motivational speakers, but the most profound and enduring source of inspiration is found in the Bible. The timeless truths in God’s Word offer more than just comfort; they provide a roadmap for living a life of purpose, peace, and joy. At Shout of Triumph, we are dedicated to sharing these powerful Bible Verses that inspire, uplift, and encourage believers to deepen their faith and draw closer to God.

God’s love is more than just an abstract concept; it’s the very foundation of our lives. His love provides strength in moments of weakness, peace in times of chaos, and hope when the future seems uncertain. At Shout of Triumph, we are passionate about sharing the transformative power of God's love through carefully selected Bible Verses that resonate with the challenges and triumphs of daily life.

One of the most comforting passages is Psalm 23, where David speaks of the Lord as his Shepherd. This verse reminds us that, no matter what we face, God is guiding us, providing for our needs, and leading us beside still waters. In those moments when life feels overwhelming, this verse offers the assurance that we are not alone, and our Good Shepherd is always by our side.

Similarly, the profound truth of John 3:16 encapsulates the depth of God’s love for humanity. "For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son," a verse that is central to our faith, offering the promise of eternal life through Jesus Christ. This verse reminds us of the ultimate sacrifice made out of love, and how this gift of salvation offers hope and redemption to all who believe.

Trusting in God’s wisdom rather than our own is beautifully expressed in Proverbs 3:5-6. "Trust in the Lord with all your heart," we are urged, for it is God who directs our paths. In a world filled with uncertainty, this verse encourages us to lean on God’s understanding and find peace in His divine guidance.

When life’s trials weigh us down, the reassurance found in Matthew 11:28-30 brings comfort: "Come to Me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." Jesus’ invitation to find rest in Him is a powerful reminder that, no matter our burdens, we can find peace and solace in His embrace.

The promise of a hopeful future is declared in Jeremiah 29:11: "For I know the plans I have for you, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future." This verse is a beacon of hope, assuring us that God’s plans for us are good and filled with purpose.

For those seeking strength to face life’s challenges, Philippians 4:13 offers an empowering declaration: "I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me." This verse reminds us that our strength comes not from ourselves, but from Christ who empowers us to overcome any obstacle.

At Shout of Triumph, we believe in the power of Bible Verses to inspire, encourage, and strengthen believers in their walk with Christ. Whether you’re seeking comfort, hope, or spiritual growth, our content is designed to meet you where you are, offering Christian Motivation and Faith-Based Content that speaks to the heart.

As you meditate on these scriptures, may you find the peace, strength, and hope that only God can provide. Let the Word of God be your guide, and allow His love to transform your life.

snippet.title: Celebrate karna to banata hai #gulabjamun #harjeetcooks #minivlog #shortsfeed #shorts #familyvlog
snippet.description:
Harjeet Cooks family ne cross kar liya 500K (5 Lakh) subscribers ka shandaar milestone, aur khushi ke mauke par Mummy ne banaye instant Bread Gulab Jamun! 🥳❤️✨

Aaj Papa aur Baani ne party popper phod kar Mummy aur Angad ko bohot bada surprise diya—humaare YouTube channel par 500,000 subscribers poore ho gaye hain! Itni badi khushi ke mauke par meetha banna toh banta tha, toh Mummy ne kitchen mein bina khoya aur bina mawa ke bread aur doodh se banaye super soft, juicy aur rasbhare Bread Gulab Jamun!

Aap sabke bina shart pyaar aur support ke bina yeh possible nahi tha! Thank you so much humari poori family ki taraf se! ❤️

🛒 Instant Bread Gulab Jamun Samagri:

Gulab Jamun Dough: White bread slices (sides cut kiye hue), halka gunguna doodh (soft dough banane ke liye) aur deep frying ke liye tel/ghee.

Chashni (Sugar Syrup): Cheeni, paani, hari elaichi aur kesar ke dhaage (saffron).

👩‍🍳 Banane ka Aasan Tareeka:

Bread slices ke brown kinare kaat kar alag karein aur white part ko bowl mein tod lein.

Thoda-thoda doodh daal kar smooth aur soft dough goondh lein.

Chhoti-chhoti bina crack wali smooth balls bana lein.

Pan mein cheeni, paani, elaichi aur kesar daal kar chipchipi chashni taiyar karein.

Medium-low flame par bread balls ko golden brown hone tak fry karein.

Fried gulab jamun ko gunguni chashni mein 15–20 minute ke liye daal kar chhod dein.

Rasbhare soft gulab jamun taiyar hain!

Aapko humari recipe videos mein sabse zyada kya dekhna pasand hai? Comments mein zaroor batayein aur aise hi apna pyaar banaye rakhein! 👇❤️
